_meta.title: KOEL — FY25 actuals (market anchors)
_meta.primarySource: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd — Annual Report FY 2024-25
_meta.note: KOEL discloses Power Gen as a separate sub-segment within B2B in the MD&A. Consolidated segment reporting splits only B2B / B2C / Financial Services — so Power Gen EBIT is not independently disclosed.

rows.label: Total revenue (standalone)
rows.notes: Standalone revenue. Consolidated FY25 revenue is ₹6,349.13 Cr (incl. Financial Services).

rows.label: Net profit (standalone)
rows.source: KOEL AR FY24-25, p.20 (Net Profit chart)

rows.label: Power Gen segment revenue (standalone)
rows.source: KOEL AR FY24-25, p.20 (Segment wise revenue highlights)
rows.notes: FY22: ₹1,297 · FY23: ₹1,655 · FY24: ₹1,905 · FY25: ₹1,969. Largest sub-segment inside B2B (49% of consolidated B2B per Q1 FY26 IR deck).

rows.label: B2B consolidated segment revenue
rows.source: KOEL AR FY24-25, p.322 (Consolidated segment reporting)
rows.notes: B2B PBET = ₹489.53 Cr (10.9% margin). Covers Power Gen + Industrial + D&AM + Exports.

rows.label: Industrial segment revenue (standalone)
rows.source: KOEL AR FY24-25, p.20 (Segment wise revenue highlights)
rows.notes: FY24: ₹1,008 Cr. +12% YoY, driven by construction / infrastructure demand.

rows.label: International B2B revenue (standalone)
rows.notes: FY24: ₹520 Cr. -6% YoY — geopolitical drag in MENA.

rows.label: Total export sales (standalone)
rows.source: KOEL AR FY24-25, p.23 (Manufacturing capital — Outputs)
rows.notes: Standalone. Consolidated export (incl. B2C) is ₹702.50 Cr per segment note p.323.

rows.label: Total gensets sold
rows.source: KOEL AR FY24-25, p.23 (Manufacturing capital — Outputs)
rows.notes: Aggregate across all kVA bands. Power Gen-only volume is not disclosed separately.

rows.label: Avg realization per genset (implied)
rows.notes: Rough triangulation. Denominator includes non-Power-Gen gensets, so actual Power-Gen realization is higher. Treat as floor.

rows.label: CPCB IV+ share of Power Gen revenue
rows.notes: Not disclosed. CPCB IV+ became mandatory 01-Jul-2024 for gensets up to 800 kW — FY25 is first full year. Flag as question for management commentary.
